objectives.description: Type with increasing speed and accuracy using correct home-row finger technique
Type fluently and accurately, using keyboard shortcuts to edit and format text efficiently
Identify a range of ways to report concerns about content and contact online
Explain how to keep personal information private and recognise online risks
Understand acceptable and unacceptable online behaviour, including the responsible use of social media and online games
Evaluate the credibility and reliability of online sources and search results
Design and use an algorithm to solve a problem, and understand that algorithms are implemented as programs on digital devices
Use logical reasoning to detect and correct errors in an algorithm (debugging)
Design, write and debug programs that accomplish specific goals, including controlling or simulating physical systems
Use logical reasoning to explain how a more complex algorithm, involving nested selection and repetition, works
Use sequence, selection and repetition in programs; work with variables and inputs/outputs
Use nested selection and repetition, and multiple variables, to build more complex programs
Select, use and combine software/services on a range of digital devices to design and create content
Understand computer networks, including the internet, and how they provide multiple services such as the World Wide Web
Select, use and combine a variety of software on a range of digital devices to design, create, collaborate on, and evaluate content that accomplishes given goals
Explain how computer networks, including the internet, work, including the opportunities they offer for communication and collaboration
